serial.pesan: Subuh lebih berharga dari dunia dan isinya

youtube.title: Bangun Subuh Tanpa Alarm 5 Kali | Uwais Hijrah #2
youtube.description:
Alarm Subuh udah bunyi lima kali... Uwais kalah sama selimut?

Dua rakaat sebelum Subuh lebih baik daripada dunia dan seisinya. (HR. Muslim 725)

Hari 2 dari 30.

#30HariUwaisHijrah #JOTA #shorts

shots.title: Hook: snooze
shots.adegan: Uwais lies in the bed on the left under the grey blanket, his head on the pillow turned toward the camera, his right arm resting on the blanket; one smartphone glows and rings on the nightstand.
alur: The phone on the nightstand glows and rings.
Uwais slowly reaches out with his right hand and taps the phone screen once.
His right hand returns to the blanket and he stays lying still.
shots.gerak: Uwais slowly reaches out with his right hand, taps the phone screen once to stop the alarm, and rests his hand back on the blanket.

benda.letak: flat on the nightstand, screen up, touched by Uwais's right hand
benda.akhir: flat on the nightstand, screen dark

shots.kamera: medium-wide shot from the foot of the bed, static
shots.akhir: Uwais lies still under the blanket; the phone lies dark on the nightstand.
shots.latar: A dark bedroom before dawn: a wall clock ticking clearly, crickets outside, a distant rooster, quiet room tone.

foley.suara: a smartphone alarm beeping, three short beeps
a finger tapping a phone screen once

shots.title: Trigger: fifth alarm
shots.adegan: Uwais lies in the same bed under the grey blanket; the same phone lies on the nightstand.
alur: The phone glows and rings again.
Uwais lifts his head from the pillow and props himself up on his left elbow.
He stays propped up, his body turned toward the phone.
shots.gerak: The phone rings again; Uwais lifts his head from the pillow and props himself up on his left elbow, turned toward the phone.

benda.letak: flat on the nightstand, screen up
benda.akhir: flat on the nightstand, screen glowing

shots.kamera: medium shot from the foot of the bed, static
shots.akhir: Uwais is propped up on his left elbow in bed, the phone glowing on the nightstand.
shots.latar: A dark bedroom before dawn: a wall clock ticking, crickets, roosters crowing in the distance.

foley.suara: a smartphone alarm beeping, three short beeps

shots.title: Aba at the door

dialog.text: [warm] Uwais, bangun, Nak. Sudah Subuh. Aba tunggu di depan, ya.

shots.lokasi: the doorway of Uwais's small bedroom before dawn, seen from inside the room: a wooden door open on the right, a light switch on the wall beside it, a dim hallway behind, a dark blue window glow from the left.
shots.adegan: Aba stands in the open doorway on the right in his long white thobe, his right hand near the light switch on the wall, his body facing into the room.
alur: He presses the light switch with his right hand and the room light turns on.
He lowers his hand and stands calmly facing the room.
shots.gerak: Aba presses the light switch with his right hand, the room light turns on, and he lowers his hand and stands calmly in the doorway.
shots.kamera: medium-wide shot at eye level, static
shots.akhir: Aba stands calmly in the lit doorway facing the room.
shots.latar: A quiet house before dawn: a wall clock ticking, crickets fading, a distant rooster.

foley.suara: a plastic wall light switch clicking once

shots.title: Choice: beat the blanket

dialog.text: [softly] Aba udah siap... masa aku kalah sama selimut?

shots.lokasi: Uwais's small bedroom before dawn with the ceiling light now on: a single bed with a grey blanket, a wooden nightstand with one phone, a wooden door on the right, a dark blue window.
shots.adegan: Uwais sits up on the edge of the bed with his feet on the floor, the grey blanket around his waist, facing the camera at a three-quarter angle.
alur: Uwais stretches both arms up over his head.
He pushes the blanket aside with his right hand.
He stands up beside the bed, facing the door on the right.
shots.gerak: Uwais stretches both arms up, pushes the blanket aside with his right hand, and stands up beside the bed facing the door.

benda.letak: around Uwais's waist, pushed by his right hand

shots.kamera: medium-wide shot at eye level, static
shots.akhir: Uwais stands beside the bed facing the door; the blanket lies on the bed.

shots.title: Hadith: dawn
shots.narration: [calm] Dua rakaat sebelum Subuh lebih baik daripada dunia dan seisinya. HR. Muslim.
